goals.title: Compose CNFs with disjoint variables
goals.statementDisplay:
def DisjointSAT : Prop := ∀ (f g : CNF), DisjointCNFVars f g →
  (Satisfiable (List.append f g) ↔ Satisfiable f ∧ Satisfiable g)
goals.suggestedDependenciesMeaning: Reading relationships only; no imported proof, required dependency or point allocation.
goals.description: Disjoint variable sets let two independently satisfiable CNFs share one combined assignment.
goals.limits: This exact reference proof is publicly disclosed; validation/integration only, no independent discovery or automatic credit.

goals.title: Freshen components into disjoint namespaces
goals.statementDisplay:
def FreshenNamespaces : Prop := ∀ (f g : CNF),
  DisjointCNFVars (renameCNF leftVar f) (renameCNF rightVar g)
goals.suggestedDependenciesMeaning: Reading relationships only; no imported proof, required dependency or point allocation.
goals.description: Prove the even-variable namespace and odd-variable namespace are disjoint for all CNF components.
goals.limits: Disjointness extension only. Previously credited renaming/equisatisfiability facts are excluded from reward; no runtime bound or new reduction.

goals.title: Verify one-variable clause restriction
goals.statementDisplay:
def ClauseRestriction : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat → Bool) (x : Nat) (b : Bool) (c : Clause),
  evalRestrictedClause a (restrictClause x b c) = evalClause (assignVar a x b) c
goals.suggestedDependenciesMeaning: Reading relationships only; no imported proof, required dependency or point allocation.
goals.description: Prove exact Boolean evaluation after removing falsified literals or recognizing a satisfied clause.
goals.limits: Nonrewardable supporting milestone inside cnf_restriction; its singleton-CNF converse means a separate award would duplicate essentially the same result.

goals.title: Lift restriction correctness to CNFs
goals.statementDisplay:
def CNFRestriction : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat → Bool) (x : Nat) (b : Bool) (f : CNF),
  evalCNF a (restrictCNF x b f) = evalCNF (assignVar a x b) f
goals.suggestedDependenciesMeaning: Reading relationships only; no imported proof, required dependency or point allocation.
goals.description: Prove evaluation of the restricted CNF equals original evaluation with the chosen variable overridden.
goals.limits: Known semantic infrastructure; no SAT solver completeness or complexity claim.

goals.title: Preserve satisfiability for one forced unit step
goals.statementDisplay:
def UnitPropagation : Prop := ∀ (x : Nat) (b : Bool) (f : CNF),
  List.Mem [(x, b)] f → (Satisfiable (restrictCNF x b f) ↔ Satisfiable f)
goals.suggestedDependenciesMeaning: Reading relationships only; no imported proof, required dependency or point allocation.
goals.description: When the exact unit clause is a member of the formula, prove that assigning its literal and restricting preserves satisfiability.
goals.limits: Deferred until verified dependency attribution is supported. One step only; not iteration, a DPLL solver or a complexity result.
